purpose: Shared importer decisions for converting candidate trail research into normalized candidate artifacts before any runtime app integration.

decisionPrecedence: This file resolves shared importer-model questions for candidate normalization.
Trail-specific hard blockers in normalization-handoff.research.json still block that trail or section until resolved.
If a trail-specific handoff is stricter than this shared file, use the stricter rule.
If a source/legal/currentness fact is unstable or not verified, keep it as a blocker or publication-time recheck.

existingRuntimeContract.trailSections: Runtime trail systems use section shards with distanceKm, route.status, route.sourceFormat, optional endpointCoordinates, accessPoints and facilities.
existingRuntimeContract.routeGroups: Runtime route groups already support kind mainline, branch, access and connector.
existingRuntimeContract.connections: Runtime connections already support modes same-island, walk, bus, ferry, rowboat and none. Ferry and rowboat route geometry must remain planning-reference or not-for-navigation.
existingRuntimeContract.importantConstraint: Candidate normalized artifacts may carry richer planning metadata than runtime shards. Runtime import must either map those fields to supported app fields or wait for an explicit schema/app change.

candidateArtifactLayout.decision: Create candidate-only normalized artifacts before runtime import.
candidateArtifactLayout.runtimeWritePolicy: Do not write data/source/hiking, public/data or public/routes from these candidate artifacts until a separate runtime integration task is explicitly requested.

distancePolicy.decision: Store official/display distance and computed geometry distance separately.

canonicalFieldsForCandidateArtifacts.officialDistanceKm: Trail-manager or selected official user-facing distance.
canonicalFieldsForCandidateArtifacts.computedGeometryDistanceKm: Distance computed from selected normalized geometry.
canonicalFieldsForCandidateArtifacts.displayDistanceKm: Defaults to officialDistanceKm unless a trail-specific handoff selects a different value.
canonicalFieldsForCandidateArtifacts.distanceCaveats: Source contradictions, rounded totals, stale values and measured-distance notes.

distancePolicy.runtimeMapping: Current runtime section distanceKm should receive displayDistanceKm. Computed geometry distance remains provenance/QA metadata unless the app schema is extended.
distancePolicy.totalDistancePolicy: Do not force section distances to sum to a marketing whole-trail distance. Preserve claimed whole-trail totals separately when they differ.

geometryPolicy.decision: Use selected canonical route geometry as provenance, and create separate display-ready geometry only when needed for rendering.
geometryPolicy.coordinatePolicy: All candidate GeoJSON must be WGS84 longitude-latitude coordinate order. Transform EPSG:3006 or other source CRS before candidate artifact output and record the transform.
sourcePriority: Official trail-manager GPX/API/GeoJSON or official state trail linework when source policy allows it.
Current official presentation source such as Naturkartan when it is the trail manager's public map baseline.
OSM/Waymarked/third-party sources only as QA, fallback or explicit low-confidence source when the handoff says so.
geometryPolicy.segmentPolicy: Preserve official track, segment and MultiLineString breaks unless an explicit sourced connector is modeled.
geometryPolicy.densificationPolicy: Densification is allowed only for draw/display artifacts and must not be treated as field-verified trail geometry.
geometryPolicy.simplificationPolicy: Do not simplify canonical candidate geometry until an importer-specific tolerance is chosen and visually QAed.

endpointContinuityPolicy.decision: Preserve source endpoints and create explicit graph/connection records instead of silently moving route lines.

snapThresholds.action: May create a shared logical routeGraphNode when section identities and source context agree. Preserve original endpoints in provenance.
Do not snap silently. Create a reviewed walk connection or endpoint-zone note if the same trailhead/settlement context supports it.
Do not snap. Model as an access connector, transfer, known discontinuity, or blocker.

endpointContinuityPolicy.barrierRule: Any gap involving water, road ferry, bus/road transfer, unverified self-navigation, missing official linework, private land or an official network break must be modeled explicitly even when short.

routeTopologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

routeTopologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
routeTopologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

partialAndSelfNavigationPolicy.decision: Partial or self-navigation sections are not imported as ordinary complete route geometry.
candidateHandling: Keep partial geometry as research/candidate geometry with explicit missing span metadata.
Do not include partial sections in default through-route presets unless the UI can show the gap clearly.
Use route.status missing-gpx or marker-only only if runtime UX explicitly supports a missing-route section; otherwise defer the section from runtime import.
partialAndSelfNavigationPolicy.defaultUserExperience: Show route chains before and after the blocker separately or with a visible gap/transfer warning, never as a seamless line.

directionReversalPolicy.decision: Normalize candidate section geometry to official section order while preserving source direction metadata.

candidateFields.directionCaveat: text when source labels, GPX order or endpoints conflict

directionReversalPolicy.runtimeMapping: Runtime route files should be emitted in official section order unless the app later supports bidirectional source direction metadata.

facilityStatePolicy.decision: Normalize facilities through explicit import actions, not by deleting caveats.
runtimeMapping: Only import, import-as-access, import-as-rule-warning and attach-to-parent records may become runtime data.
Pending-review and suppress records remain in research/candidate artifacts and must not appear as normal user-facing facilities.
Side-trip metadata can become user-facing only if the route or POI is intentionally modeled as a side trip.
facilityStatePolicy.parentClusterPolicy: Cluster first, then split typed subfacilities only where coordinates, confidence and app taxonomy justify separate markers.
facilityStatePolicy.parkingAndTransitPolicy: Parking and transit should be treated consistently with existing app trails: import verified, useful access records as user-facing parking/transit facilities or accessPoints, dedupe them by cluster, and keep timetable/parking-rule details caveated and live-checkable.
facilityStatePolicy.informalTentingPolicy: Informal tenting remains a separate candidate category. Promote to runtime camping only when rules and coordinates support it; otherwise keep as caveated rule/access text or pending-review.
facilityStatePolicy.privateCommercialPolicy: Private, customer-only, seasonal or opening-hours-dependent services can be imported only with clear caveats and publication-time recheck requirements.

ruleWarningPolicy.decision: Only hiker-facing warnings should reach runtime user surfaces.
runtimeEligibleWarnings: legal or local rules that affect hiking behavior
route hazards and known current-condition warnings
camping, fire, dog, cycling, bathing, fishing, water-protection and access restrictions
source contradictions that change how a hiker should plan or navigate
runtimeIneligibleWarnings: debug notes about snapping, reversing, geometry repair or section assignment unless rewritten as hiker-facing caveats
ruleWarningPolicy.granularity: Prefer subsegment or facility/site-level warnings after GIS overlay. Use whole-section warnings only when exact subsegment scope is unknown but the warning is important.
ruleWarningPolicy.currentness: Fire bans, temporary closures, forestry/storm damage, ferry/boat service, transit, business openings, water reliability and cabin/hut season must be rechecked immediately before publication.

overlapDedupePolicy.decision: Use canonical route/facility records for overlapping trails and attach aliases/sectionRefs instead of duplicating data.
overlapDedupePolicy.geometryDedupe: If two trails share the same physical geometry, choose one canonical geometry artifact and let the other trail reference it with alias/provenance metadata. Keep a trail-specific override only where research shows an actual route difference.
overlapDedupePolicy.facilityDedupe: Create one canonical candidate facility/place record per real-world object with multiple trailRefs or sectionRefs. Do not duplicate shared huts, shelters, water points, transit stops or services per trail.
overlapDedupePolicy.ruleWarningDedupe: Share identical area or facility rule warnings across overlapping trails but keep trail-specific planning text where route context differs.

sourceAndCurrentnessPolicy.decision: Separate durable import decisions from volatile publication checks.

bohusleden.stage21: Do not import Stage 21 as complete route geometry. Importable chains are stages 1-20 and 22-27 unless a later runtime UX supports an explicit partial/self-navigation stage.
bohusleden.stage8To9Gap: Treat the 49.4 m Bottenstugan continuity gap as an explicit reviewed walk connection or endpoint-zone note, not an endpoint snap.
bohusleden.wholeTrailDisplay: Do not draw Bohusleden as one seamless continuous line through Stage 21.

hallandsleden.officialBreaks: Preserve official MultiLineString/segment breaks for N5, K3 and K4.
hallandsleden.k4ToK5Gap: Represent Frillesås-to-Steninge as a visible official network gap with connection mode none unless an official connector is later published.
hallandsleden.geometrySource: Use canonical geometry for provenance and draw-ready geometry only for display QA.

hogakustenleden.section2Distance: Use Höga Kusten 26.8 km as display distance and preserve Naturkartan/GPX contradictions as metadata.
hogakustenleden.section7Difficulty: Use the conservative Naturkartan red/krävande posture and preserve Höga Kusten Medel as a caveat.
hogakustenleden.slattdalsskrevan: Model as a hiker-facing hazard/avoid-through-passage warning unless newer official notices change the wording.
hogakustenleden.seasonalBoats: Model Ullånger/Ulvön/Köpmanholmen/Kläppa boats as optional onward or side access, not required trail crossings.

hoglandsleden.topology: Model the trail as the official main loop plus explicit branch/access/connectors rather than one undifferentiated chain.
hoglandsleden.accessTrails: Mariannelund, Sävsjö C, Hok station, Byarum kyrka, Skillingaryd station and Lyngemadens access context should be access groups or access metadata, not silently merged into main sections.
hoglandsleden.weakTransit: Very weak rural transit remains caveated access metadata unless useful current service is verified.
hoglandsleden.commercialServices: Bookable, seasonal, customer-only or otherwise commercial services may be included only as service/access metadata with opening/access conditions in the description; do not import them as ordinary public trail facilities unless the section packet explicitly supports that.

kungsleden.sourcePolicy: Use official/state trail geometry as the primary candidate geometry where source policy permits; keep Naturkartan/API/GPX, OSM/Waymarked, transit feeds and field-report metadata as candidate research/QA or publication-check inputs until source terms are explicitly approved for runtime import.
kungsleden.connectors: Boat, rowboat, ferry, water and road/bus gaps must be typed connectors or access metadata, not straight hiking lines. Runtime import still needs connector-schema support before these can become app data.
kungsleden.hutClusters: Hut yards are parent clusters; split toilets, emergency phones, saunas, shops, waste and water only when source coordinates and taxonomy support it.
kungsleden.facilityTaxonomy: Map Kungsleden facilities to the existing normalized types first: huts/lodging as parent lodging or shelter clusters, toilets/toalett, emergency phones, food/shop, sauna/service, waste, managed water, bridges/hazards, viewpoints/attractions, Naturum/heritage-or-attraction, village services, parking and transit. Keep unverified child amenities pending instead of inventing standalone POIs.
kungsleden.sideRoutes: Singi-Kebnekaise/Nikkaluokta, Sytertoppen/Hemavan alternates and similar lines are access/alternate metadata unless a side-route import is explicitly selected.

nordkalottleden.importScope: Normalize only the researched 12-section Reisa/Käsivarsi/Kautokeino model first; defer whole-trail southern variants and alternate endpoint logic.
nordkalottleden.gaps: Keep Saarijärvi, Saraelv/Ovi, Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi and source-boundary gaps explicit as connectors, endpoint zones or blockers.
nordkalottleden.legacyEndpoints: Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi remains legacy/access metadata and not active lodging unless newer source evidence changes it.
nordkalottleden.countryRuleWarnings: Use per-section or per-country warnings when rules differ between Finland, Norway and Sweden. Use route-level warnings only for facts that apply to the whole researched model, and keep dynamic legal/currentness checks for publication time.

ostkustleden.controllingPlan: Use normalization-plan.research.json as the detailed per-section plan.
ostkustleden.etapp8Endpoint: Keep the 156.4 m Lilla Hycklinge cabin gap as metadata unless a separately sourced access leg is approved.
ostkustleden.prototypeFirst: Build candidate-only geometry artifacts and visually QA them before runtime source data is touched.

padjelantaleden.headlineDistance: Do not publish a single asserted headline distance until geometry split review chooses the official display value and records competing source totals.
padjelantaleden.boatAndHelicopter: M/S Storlule, Kvikkjokk-Bobäcken, helicopter midpoint access and Gamájåhkå alternatives are connectors/access metadata, not normal hiking geometry.
padjelantaleden.hutSubfacilities: Attach hut toilets, water, waste, shops/provisions and sauna-like services to parent hut clusters by default; split only high-confidence public standalone records.

sjuharadsleden.qualityAssurance: Keep the Naturkartan/Västkuststiftelsen not-fully-quality-assured caveat visible until newer official source removes it.
sjuharadsleden.naturalWater: Natural water/lake/spring features can be natural/bathing/rest context but not potable water.

tjustleden.schemaNeed: Candidate artifacts must support officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, endpoint clusters, tails/connectors and source-direction reversal metadata before runtime import.
tjustleden.loopsAndConnectors: Keep loops/connectors out of the main 9-stage route unless represented as separate connector/tail objects.
tjustleden.naturalWater: Suppress natural water as potable unless reliable point-source evidence is verified.

vastra-vatterleden.geometryPrototype: Build candidate-only route and connector geometry before runtime integration.
vastra-vatterleden.rankasleden: Keep Rankåsleden and regional long-distance links as future connector metadata unless explicitly selected for this import pass.
vastra-vatterleden.optionalBusinesses: Optional businesses and town services should be side-service/access metadata with opening/access conditions in descriptions, not ordinary on-trail facilities, unless a section packet gives source-backed coordinates and clear public trail relevance.

vikingaleden.trailLevelMetadata: The existing vikingaleden/trail.research.json generated from completed section packets is the candidate trail overview for this prep pass; a later official overview pass can update it without blocking normalization.
vikingaleden.overlapRuntimeModel: For sections 7-12, use canonical Upplandsleden geometry and shared canonical facilities where the route physically matches; Vikingaleden gets route alias/provenance metadata and only trail-specific overrides where it diverges.
vikingaleden.sharedFacilities: Shared facilities on the overlap should be one canonical candidate record with both trailRefs/sectionRefs, not duplicates per trail.
vikingaleden.parkingAndTransit: Treat parking/transit consistently with other app trails: import verified useful access markers or accessPoints, deduped by cluster.
vikingaleden.branchFeatures: Stormon/Grillholmen and other branch/context amenities remain pending until branch/side-route handling is explicit.
vikingaleden.ruleWarnings: Only hiker-facing rule warnings should become visible; provenance/normalization notes remain suppressed.

remainingExternalBlockers.notes: This pass chooses the data model. Runtime import still needs approval for any source terms, licensing, or redistribution constraints that are not already accepted for the app.
Current runtime sections do not natively store officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, sourceDirection, reversalApplied, candidate import actions, or canonical cross-trail facility IDs.
Protected-area, water-protection, restriction-zone and subsegment rule warnings need final GIS overlay against selected normalized geometry.
Dynamic safety, access, transport, commercial and water/service facts must be refreshed near publication.

instructions: Create candidate-only normalized artifacts under each trail folder using this shared decision file plus that trail's normalization handoff.
Start with trails that already have complete geometry artifacts: Hallandsleden, Bohusleden importable stages, Nordkalottleden 12-section model, and Ostkustleden prototype.
Do not write runtime app source or generated public output until candidate artifacts pass parse, topology, facility dedupe and warning-scope checks.
Where a trail-specific blocker remains, create a blocker entry in import-report.research.json instead of inventing data.
